options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Active Hubs
options.doc: Choose which games' hubs and bosses are used. Does not filter the level pool.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez les hubs et les boss des jeux utilisés. Ne filtre pas la piscine de niveau.

options.name: Hub Area Locks
options.doc:
Require AP area-unlock items for later islands, elevator floors and gated hub sections.

Crash 1 has Progressive Island Access items,
Crash 2 has Progressive Elevator Access items
Crash 3 sections has Hub Section X Unlock items.

options.name: Level Access Locks
options.doc:
Require each selected level's Access item. Independent of Hub Area Locks.

When disabled, selected levels only require their hub area and secret-route requirements.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Choose what the player must complete to win.

All Cortex requires defeating Cortex in every active hub game.
Single-Cortex goals require that game's hub to be active.
Cortex entrances follow the chosen hub area and level access locks.

Level clears count distinct regular levels from the selected destination pool.

Token hunt replaces a percentage of filler items with AP Tokens.
Collecting the required percentage of those tokens wins.
options.doc_fr:
Choisissez ce que le joueur doit compléter pour gagner.

Tout Cortex nécessite de vaincre Cortex dans chaque jeu de hub actif.
Les buts mono-corptex exigent que le hub du jeu soit actif.
Les entrées Cortex suivent la zone de moyeu choisie et les serrures d'accès de niveau.

Le niveau efface compte différents niveaux réguliers du bassin de destination sélectionné.

La chasse aux jetons remplace un pourcentage des articles de remplissage par des jetons AP.
Recueillir le pourcentage requis de ces jetons gagne.

options.name: Require All Goal Campaign Bosses
options.doc:
Require every boss, including Cortex, in the campaigns targeted by the goal.

Applies only to Cortex goals. Required bosses are included even if omitted
from the level pool. Level-clear and token-hunt goals are unaffected.
Cortex Last also locks each goal campaign's Cortex until its other bosses are defeated.

options.name: Cortex Unlock Requirements
options.doc:
Extra requirements before the goal's Cortex entrances unlock.

Select level_clears, token_hunt, or both. Every selected requirement must
be met, then defeat the goal bosses to win. Used only with Cortex goals.
options.doc_fr:
Exigences supplémentaires avant le déverrouillage des entrées Cortex du but.

Sélectionnez level clears, token hunt ou les deux. Chaque exigence sélectionnée doit être satisfaite, puis vaincre les patrons de but pour gagner. Utilisé uniquement avec des buts Cortex.

options.name: Goal Count
options.doc: Distinct regular levels to clear for the level-clears goal or Cortex requirement.
options.doc_fr: Distinct des niveaux réguliers à effacer pour le but de niveau-clear ou l'exigence Cortex.

options.name: Token Hunt Filler Percentage
options.doc: Percentage of filler slots replaced with AP Tokens for token hunt or a Cortex requirement.

options.name: Token Hunt Required Percentage
options.doc: Percentage of the available AP Tokens required to win or unlock the goal Cortex bosses.

options.name: Available Level Pool
options.doc:
Allowed levels, grouped under crash_1, crash_2 and crash_3.

Remove unwanted levels. An empty list or omitted game excludes its levels.
Use titles, full names or level keys.
Secret routes also need their source levels in the pool.
options.doc_fr:
Niveaux autorisés, regroupés sous crash 1, crash 2 et crash 3.

Enlever les niveaux indésirables. Une liste vide ou un jeu omis exclut ses niveaux.
Utilisez les titres, les noms complets ou les touches de niveau.
Les routes secrètes ont également besoin de leurs niveaux de source dans la piscine.

options.name: Level Count
options.doc:
Total regular levels to draw from Level Pool, including secret stages.

Limited by the pool and available hub entrances. Bosses are added separately.

options.name: Starting Levels per Hub
options.doc:
Number of starting level entrances per active hub.

Fills the earliest hub areas available among the selected entrances first,
then unlocks more if needed.

options.name: White Gem Checks Percent
options.doc: Percentage of eligible white-gem checks in selected levels.

options.name: Colored Gem Checks Percent
options.doc: Percentage of eligible colored-gem checks in selected levels.

options.name: Power Crystal Checks Percent
options.doc: Percentage of eligible power-crystal checks in selected levels.

options.name: Relic Checks Percent
options.doc: Percentage of eligible relic checks in selected levels.

options.name: Level Placement Shuffle
options.doc:
Shuffle regular level destinations. Bosses and secret stages keep their entrances.

Across Campaigns can place any pool level in any active hub.
Off and Within Campaign use only levels belonging to the active hubs.
Secret stages keep their vanilla paths and need their source levels in the pool.

options.name: Boxsanity Percent
options.doc: Percentage of eligible breakable boxes in selected levels that become AP checks.

options.name: Collectible Rewards
options.doc:
Reward modes for power_crystals, white_gems, colored_gems and relics (ankhs).

randomized (default): shuffle selected rewards.
vanilla: selected checks keep their original local rewards.
precollected: shuffle selected rewards and grant unselected collectibles at startup.

options.name: Box Item Classification Spoilers
options.doc: Color selected, reachable AP boxes by their item classification.
options.doc_fr: Couleur sélectionnée, les boîtes AP accessibles selon leur classement d'article.

options.name: Crashsanity
options.doc:
Experimental: assign Crash 1/2/3 basic movement rules per regular level.

F10 restores vanilla controls if a style prevents progress.
options.doc_fr:
Experimental: assigner Crash 1/2/3 règles de base de mouvement par niveau régulier.

F10 restaure les contrôles de la vanille si un style empêche les progrès.
